episodes.name: The Devil and D.B. Russell
episodes.overview: D.B. Russell leads the CSI team on a hunt to find Morgan and Ellie Brass following their kidnapping by a ritualistic killer.

episodes.name: Take the Money and Run
episodes.overview: The CSI team investigate a murder at a high stakes poker game.

episodes.name: Torch Song
episodes.overview: The CSI team investigates a fire at a music venue that leaves four people dead, including two band members.

episodes.name: Last Supper
episodes.overview: When contestants on a reality cooking show accidentally eat human flesh during a competition, the CSI team is brought in to investigate.

episodes.name: Frame by Frame
episodes.overview: The team meets a blast from the past, with a chance to solve a cold case that has haunted the team for 14 years.

episodes.name: Passed Pawns
episodes.overview: The CSI team investigates the death of a homeless man who had a huge winning streak at a small casino.

episodes.name: Under a Cloud
episodes.overview: A body is discovered during torrential rain in Vegas; Sanders is accused of framing a man for murder seven years ago.

episodes.name: Helpless
episodes.overview: A dead man is found inside a human-size hamster ball; the team collaborates on a serial rapist investigation.

episodes.name: Check In and Check Out
episodes.overview: The CSI team is called in to investigate the stabbing of a couple found at a local motel that is reminiscent of two incidents that occurred in the same room.

episodes.name: Girls Gone Wild
episodes.overview: A spa weekend for Sara, Finlay and Morgan turns into a murder investigation and missing persons case when Finlay disappears, as the CSI team must piece together what happened in detail to find her.

episodes.name: The Lost Reindeer
episodes.overview: When a man is found murdered at an elaborate holiday party complete with real snow and live reindeer, the CSI team is brought in to investigate.

episodes.name: Keep Calm and Carry-On
episodes.overview: An inbound plane’s passengers become the victims of an onboard thief, but when one of the passengers is found dead, the petty crime turns into a murder investigation.

episodes.name: Boston Brakes
episodes.overview: The CSIs are shocked when they discover that a victim in a car crash is someone they are familiar with.

episodes.name: De Los Muertos
episodes.overview: When a woman is found dead in Mexico and a murdered couple is discovered in a driveway, evidence from one investigation could help the other.

episodes.name: Love for Sale
episodes.overview: Greg and Nick investigate the death of a 16-year-old girl with ties to a brothel.

episodes.name: Killer Moves
episodes.overview: A murdered Elvis impersonator has a strange connection with a bird.

episodes.name: Long Road Home
episodes.overview: A murdered groupie and a missing prostitute both have connections to a mysterious band.

episodes.name: Uninvited
episodes.overview: The team investigates when a whole family is reported to have been missing for a month.

episodes.name: The Fallen
episodes.overview: When a teen opens fire in a police station, Russell is taken hostage.

episodes.name: Consumed
episodes.overview: As the CSIs hunt a cannibalistic killer, they realize there is more than one.

episodes.name: Kitty
episodes.overview: The team investigates the cyber-related murder of a prominent casino owner's wife and receive help from the FBI's Cyber Crime Division.

episodes.name: Dead in His Tracks
episodes.overview: The CSIs investigate a crime that has ties to a 25-year-old mob heist; Brass is faced with a decision when his daughter tries to commit suicide.
